name: marker
title: marker
description: Convert PDF documents to Markdown using marker_single. Use when Claude needs to extract text content from PDFs while preserving LaTeX formulas, equations, and document structure. Ideal for academic papers and technical documents containing mathematical notation.

related_skills.name: pdf
related_skills.reason: Marker only converts PDFs to Markdown with formula/structure preservation; pdf covers broader PDF extraction, creation, editing, forms, and document operations.

related_skills.name: pdf-reading
related_skills.reason: Marker is a narrower PDF-reading tool focused on PDF-to-Markdown conversion preserving formulas and structure; pdf-reading includes broader text/table extraction methods.
